dict.string: Aitvaras reads new mail from Apple Mail, holds unknown senders for review, and can summarize approved senders or suggest confirmation-gated actions. Mail stays unread and no mail is ever sent automatically.
During a capture session Aitvaras transcribes system audio on-device. Audio is discarded unless you explicitly choose to retain source audio locally.
Aitvaras reads your calendar and creates events for you (she only ever modifies events she created herself).
Local-first personal AI. Cloud use is explicit.
Aitvaras uses the microphone for voice conversations and captures you start. Audio stays on this Mac and is saved only if you explicitly enable source retention for capture.
Aitvaras reads and creates reminders/todos for you.
Aitvaras transcribes speech on-device for voice conversations and captures you start.
